expectations: A memory states that `kestrel-admin rotate-key` creates the new signing key and publishes it next to the current one.

items.memory: Kestrel signs every job payload with an Ed25519 key. Rotate the key every 90 days, or at once when it may have leaked.

To rotate the Kestrel signing key, run `kestrel-admin rotate-key` on any node; it creates a new key and publishes it next to the current one. Wait until every worker reports the new key id in `kestrel-admin status`, then run `kestrel-admin retire-key <old key id>`. Payloads signed with the old key are rejected from then on.

outputs.note: the new key replaces the old one
